name: NEGATIVE_CLAIM_REQUIRES_CLOSED_SEARCH_UNIVERSE

refined_operator.statement: Given observed non-detection over search universe S, an absence claim over target scope C is admissible only when C is contained in the admitted coverage of S and detection sensitivity is adequate for C. Otherwise retain a scoped non-detection or unresolved state.
refined_operator.formal_shape: NONDETECTION(S) + C_SUBSET_OF_COVERAGE(S) + SENSITIVITY_ADEQUATE(C) -> ABSENCE_ADMISSIBLE_WITHIN_C; NONDETECTION(S) + C_NOT_SUBSET_OF_COVERAGE(S) -> GLOBAL_ABSENCE_BLOCKED

strong_examples.pattern: No reviewed shipped asset directly binds the James session to a storage object; broader storage absence remains NOT_ESTABLISHED and triggers a wider backend/session/carrier audit.
No novelty-masked local TT/TNT motif passed the frozen local search, but the result explicitly does not imply absence of longer or differently conditioned formula structure.
An older teddy literal is NOT_RECOVERED_IN_CURRENT_REPOSITORY_AND_LIBRARY_SEARCH rather than declared historically nonexistent; later recovery remains append-only admissible.
Public search exhaustion is explicitly not negative proof of participant overlap/non-overlap or underlying-data absence; author-level/controlled evidence is required to close that relation.

interpretation.machine_discovered_refinement: Across unrelated domains the negative inference is controlled by an observation boundary, not merely by the value NOT_FOUND. A negative result is a relation among the searched universe, target claim scope and detector sensitivity.
interpretation.why_humans_miss_it: The same topology is verbalized as reviewed assets, tested motif ontology, repository/library recovery, and public primary evidence. Topic vocabulary differs, while the inference boundary is isomorphic.
interpretation.important_boundary: This is strong internal held-out support for a refinement already foreshadowed by NEGATIVE_INFERENCE_TOPOLOGY. It is not a newly discovered scientific law.

next_gate: EXTERNAL_NEGATIVE_INFERENCE_TRANSPORT: freeze an independently authored corpus of machine-readable search/audit/result records containing explicit coverage fields before applying HIDDEN-006. Preserve valid negatives and NOT_APPLICABLE cases; require source-independent coverage/sensitivity semantics before any external promotion.
